about: Flash dip (docs/strategy.md, src/flash.py): BTC falls `drop` under its high of the last `window_h` hours, outside quiet hours, with no position open: BUY, sized for `risk` of the balance on the `stop` distance and capped at `cap` of it. Exits from the real fill: +target, -stop, or after hold_h hours. Tested in analyses/backtests/2026-10-19-flash-dip-vs-dip-setup.md. Set enabled to false to pause it.
